Documentation.short_help: SHYX Partitioned Collection To OpenFOAM: Write polyMesh from volume + side sets.
Documentation.long_help: Takes a vtkPartitionedDataSetCollection with an IOSS-style volume block (element_blocks) and side sets. Writes constant/polyMesh (points/faces/owner/neighbour/boundary) plus case.foam. Side sets become OpenFOAM patches using volume-point GlobalIds (and element_side as fallback). Node sets are ignored. A volume mesh is required; SHYX Selection Append Patches cannot be written as polyMesh. Output is vtkOpenFOAMReader's vtkMultiBlockDataSet (internalMesh plus patches).

InputProperty.name: Input
InputProperty.Documentation: vtkPartitionedDataSetCollection from SHYX DataSet To Partitioned Collection (volume UnstructuredGrid + side sets). Selection Append Patches is not supported.

StringVectorProperty.name: CaseDirectory
StringVectorProperty.label: Case Directory
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Root of the OpenFOAM case to write. Creates constant/polyMesh, system/controlDict, and case.foam in this folder.

IntVectorProperty.name: AllowDefaultFaces
IntVectorProperty.label: Allow Default Faces
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: If enabled, volume boundary faces not claimed by any side set are written as Default Faces Name (type wall). Default off: Apply fails when any exterior face is unassigned.

StringVectorProperty.name: DefaultFacesName
StringVectorProperty.label: Default Faces Name
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Patch name for leftover boundary faces when Allow Default Faces is on.
